podcast.title: 10-Year Career Mark
podcast.body: The group is nearing its tenth anniversary, marking a decade since their formation and the start of their career. "va a hacer ahora 10 años."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: Aggressive Media Marketing
podcast.body: There is a perception that the media attention surrounding DXX's new album is somewhat "prefabricated," largely orchestrated by their small record label, Young Turks. The label, which considers DXX a significant revenue generator, is seen as intentionally creating an "enormous snowball" of buzz around the band. "Otra cosa que está reprochando mucho es un poco la repercusión mediática que es un poco casi prefabricando alrededor del álbum de 16 o discográfica que es muy pequeña ha convertido a DXX como en la vacalechera que les da un montón de dinero."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: Album Quality vs. Expectations
podcast.body: Despite the inherent quality of the new album, certain aspects are criticized as unacceptable or as failing to meet the high demands placed on a group that releases an album only every five years, especially one that takes two years to produce a mere 10 songs. "Lo único que espero es no tener que hacer otros 5 años a para dónde nos lleva es un algún concierto de las cosas reprochables entiendo algunas críticas negativas que está teniendo pero lo que es la calidad del álbum yo creo que es una gran calidad lo que no quita que no tenga otros aspectos que no se le pueden permitir o que se le tienden a exigir a un grupo que va a hacer un álbum cada 5 años y sobre todo que se tira dos años para hacer un álbum de 10 canciones."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: British Duo
podcast.body: The xx is described as a British duo known for their minimalist electronic sound, which is considered adjacent to Dreampop.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Contemporary Dreampop Influence
podcast.body: The band is highlighted as a contemporary act that continues to embody and project many influences of dreampop, showcasing the genre's enduring and visible legacy in modern music. "me refiero con el play continuó muchas influencias del dreampop, Bafforlaces, DXX, Chromatics, The War on Drugs, The Radio Debt, yo creo que hoy ha seguido muchísimo más esa estela del dreampop o es mucho más visible."

srcs.episode: DREAM POP y SHOEGAZE. Diferencias entre ellos.

podcast.title: High Expectations for Evolution
podcast.body: Due to their infrequent album releases, which sometimes amount to only two albums in an entire decade, there is a strong expectation for a particularly robust, aggressive evolution and an incredible level of quality in their musical output. Audiences do not anticipate the slower, more typical evolution seen in other groups from a band that takes five years to produce an album. "Yo creo que todos nos esperamos una cierta evolución especialmente fuerte agresiva y una especie de increíble calidad dentro de la música que hacen porque para tomarse cinco años para hacer un álbum es lo menos que te puedes esperar."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: Influence from Interpol
podcast.body: The xx were specifically mentioned as one of the "likeminded groups" that showed an influence from Interpol's debut record, "Turn on the Bright Lights," released in 2002. "There was a little Interpol in everyone from the killers to the XX."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Influenced by Trip Hop
podcast.body: The group DXX is cited as an example of artists who would not exist today without the foundational and pervasive influence of Trip Hop, which emerged in the early 1990s. "recordemos que hoy no tendríamos grupos como DXX, sino que fue el trip hop dentro de los primeros de los 90."

srcs.episode: Massive Attack y El Origen del Trip Hop en Bristol.

podcast.title: Jamie XX's Dominant Influence
podcast.body: Over the years, DXX has increasingly been perceived as Jamie XX performing with a pair of vocalists. His significant professional evolution during the band's five-year hiatus has profoundly shaped the sound of DXX's current music, particularly influencing the background instrumentation. "Creo que ya hoy en día todos hemos asumido que DXX es que empieza a convertirse en Jamie XX con un par de cantantes."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: Lyrical Maturity Discrepancy
podcast.body: When DXX began their career, the members were in their early twenties, making their lyrics about heartbreak and adolescent struggles understandable. However, now in their thirties, an anticipated level of maturity in their lyrical content or emotional expression is notably absent from their latest album. "DXX era muy joven es cuando empezaron su carrera, tenía un poco más de 20 años, entonces esas letras y esa manera trágica hablar del desamor o de estos problemas que puede tener una persona postada al escente eran comprensibles pero ahora que tienen 30 años ya se despresopó en un grado de madurez en las letras o en la manera de expresar los sentimientos que no se ve especialmente en el álbum."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: New Album Recording Process
podcast.body: The latest DXX album underwent an extensive recording period lasting over two years. This process involved sessions in three distinct cities across two different countries, indicative of a demanding and high-level production effort. "es un álbum que se ha grabado durante más de dos años y en tres ciudades distintas de dos países."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: Oliver and Romi's Creative Stagnation
podcast.body: While Jamie XX's contributions to the background sound of DXX's music have evolved enormously, the creative input from Romi and Oliver, specifically concerning their guitars and lyrics, has not shown significant progression. Their guitar sounds are described as very similar to those on their previous two albums, and their lyrical themes and writing style remain largely unchanged. "la parte de la que han hecho ellos no ha evolucionado especialmente. Marafiro las guitarras son muy parecidos a lo que han sido los otros dos trabajos y las letras son muy similares tan del temática como en la manera de escribir o como la manera de expresar sus sentimientos."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: Overpriced Limited Edition Release
podcast.body: An expensive and unusual limited edition of the new album, priced at nearly 50 euros or dollars, was produced in such vast quantities that it began to be discounted by 10 dollars within just a month of its release. This marketing decision is highlighted as part of the label's aggressive promotional tactics. "esa carísima y extraña edición limitada que han hecho que cuesta casi 50 euros o casi 50 dólares dependiendo de dónde estéis y la cual se han fabricado tantísimas unidades que a día de hoy apenas un mes después de que salir el álbum en algunos sitios ya empieza a estar rebajada 10 dólares."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: Potential Transformation to Mass Consumption
podcast.body: There is an open question regarding whether DXX is undergoing a transformation from an independent group to one focused on mass consumption. This kind of transition is relatively common for independent bands, with varied outcomes regarding success. "no sabemos si es una transformación del grupo gran consumo, estas transformaciones de grupos independientes a tener gran consumo, gracias a veces son relativamente comunes, hay que le funcionar bien, hay a quien no le ha funcionado tan bien, pero bueno son enormemente respetables."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: Second Album Lacked Evolution
podcast.body: A notable criticism directed at DXX's second album, despite its overall quality, was its perceived lack of substantial evolutionary progression from their preceding work. "Uno de los grandes problemas que la chacábamos al segundo disco de DX6 a pesar de su normal de calidad era precisamente que no era excesivamente volutivo."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?

podcast.title: Slow Release Frequency
podcast.body: DXX maintains a release schedule of one album approximately every 4-5 years, a pace considered to be a very long wait compared to the majority of bands. This infrequent output cultivates heightened expectations for significant evolution and exceptional quality in their music. "va a ritmo de un disco de 4-5 años, yo creo que se ha hecho muchísimo esperar."
